findings.description: Candidates established by this reviewer; may be empty.

file.description: Repository-relative location associated with the candidate.

line.description: Anchor in the file, counted from 1; 0 denotes a file-wide issue.

end_line.description: Optional inclusive range end; 0 denotes no additional range.

severity.description: Impact classification independent of evidence strength.

confidence.description: Evidence strength as a percentage; agreement is not proof.

title.description: Concise label for the affected behavior.

body.description: Trigger, causal explanation, consequence and supporting evidence.

lenses.description: Assigned lens identifiers relevant to this candidate.
